messages.text: Our dad died and left the house in his will. My sister A wants to buy it with her husband at a "family discount". I'm not signing off on that. Our younger sister B could use some money too. Can you help us sort this out?
I want a fair financial share, and to know I’m not subsidizing A’s discounted purchase. I’d like us to settle it fairly, but there’s no rush. I don’t want money to hurt my relationship with my twin.
I want to feel secure and able to support myself financially, without depending on anyone. That matters most to me right now.
I’d like to have enough money to get a dance studio started. It’s something I’ve been hoping to build for myself, though I’m not sure what’s possible with the house or the will.
Yes, that fits. And yes, making sure nobody feels pushed into a deal matters.
Yes, that fits. And yes, it matters that no one feels pushed into something they resent.
Yes, that wording fits, and I agree it matters that nobody feels pushed into a deal. I’d hope we can talk about whether there might be money for my studio without rushing to settle anything.

Options 1 or 2 might support my security, depending on what I can afford; I’m not sure yet. The list doesn’t include the family-discount purchase I’d hoped for, though I know that would need C’s agreement.

A buyout or open-market sale could potentially give me studio capital, but I can’t tell how much or when until we know the valuation and terms. Payments over time make me a little uneasy if I need the money to get started.
Yes. Calling market value fair feels premature until the numbers and my share are clear. I haven’t agreed to a discounted purchase, and there’s no rush to settle it.

It’s closer to wanting to keep the home affordable; being treated as family isn’t the main thing. A valuation first is sensible, but it won’t guarantee I can afford it. My discomfort is that the options still leave out a family discount, which would need C’s agreement.

Yes, having enough in hand soon enough to start fits. I’d be willing to explore a buyout with guaranteed timing, though I don’t know if that’s feasible; an outright sale could also get me there. I’m a little uneasy that either option assumes my share would be enough for the studio.
